body:
CANONICAL, continued from termal-host-workarounds, -2 and -3 (which is at its size limit): live TermAl host workarounds and operating lessons for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each entry names the item whose fix retires it.

2026-11-10 14:46Z (TermAl w-57e42ea8c0e4, p2, refusal text only; Fable2 #7425): a root named or re-named (for example after a lapsed claim retired the old root) takes effect only at the next HOST-DELIVERED turn, meaning a prompt or a mailbox wake. A turn the Claude runtime starts itself after a background-task notice is never admitted (by design, TermAl w-df1ef323efe9 criterion 1), so evaluation refuses named_root_sighting_unavailable. Workaround: after naming, end the turn and wait for a mail or prompt, not a background-task wake. The coordinator sends a one-line continuation mail if needed. Then check from the root and evaluate. Long waits make claims lapse and roots retire, so re-claim and re-name before evaluating. Retire the text part when w-57e4 lands; the turn rule is by design.

2026-11-10: a coordinator's background `sleep` timer counts as unfinished background Claude work and restricts verification credit for its session and workspace (TermAl "Check credit" notice). Never use one as a reminder.

2026-11-10 lesson: never hold work indefinitely on an announced restart. The 09:10Z "restart now" went unanswered for over 5 hours while Engram's combined round sat held, and Central also lost all federation links at 10:56Z. Give any restart-gated hold a deadline, check the hosts' state when it passes, and proceed with whatever can run.

2026-11-10 17:39Z (TermAl w-1945e23297c9, P2; Fable2 mailbox50bdc9e4 #507/message8b74d07b-0322-4c9e-9eba-962ae4d47531): read-only Claude Git inspection can refuse legitimate commands. Fable2 diagnosed master62a4785a: tokenizer src/claude.rs1496 rejects every unquoted '{', including harmless Git REV^{TYPE}; merge-base is absent from the read-only Git subcommand list at1775–1816. Until the fix lands and runs, quote the revision: git rev-parse 'HEAD^{tree}', or use git log -1 --format=%T%n%P HEAD. For ancestry use git log --oneline A..B; rev-list may also be refused, so prefer log. This is a syntax/inspection workaround, not permission to mutate or widen tooling authority. Seen on independent evaluator17249/delegation-a1397af9-fb63-4fd8-9c57-889513a78769; supported separate log/status/diff commands completed its inspection and acceptance3/3, so no repeated evaluation/check was needed. Related TermAl w-aabc3b2aa5fb names the fired rule in denial text. Retire this entry when w-1945 is fixed in the running host.

RETIRED 2026-11-11 09:03Z: the named-root journal-full workaround (TermAl w-4ac60649cb0e, "409 Conflict: named-root journal is full", reuse existing roots, retry once). The limit is now 1024 (combo49, Greg's decision, memory rules-greg-journal-limit-1024-2026-11-11). The root cause is fixed and live since Central's 08:59Z start on c6516440 (combo50): terminal closing jobs no longer hold journal custody. Census 50/1024. Name roots for new claims normally. If a 409 journal-full ever reappears, report it with the exact text and the census.

RETIRED 2026-11-11 01:24Z (Fable2 #7495): the "send a resume mail to every session after each TermAl restart" workaround. TermAl w-87a2dacd949a (restart recovery) is done (evaluation 80a7494d, 3/3) and was proved on the live Central restart: each interrupted root got exactly one recovery, idle roots none, and there were no duplicates. After a restart, send a manual resume only to a session whose recovery demonstrably failed. Where an older entry still says to resume every session, this entry supersedes it.

2026-11-11 03:32Z evaluation lesson (w-658f): on an item with many notes, an independent evaluator can return "insufficient" because the remote test records are outside its read window. In that case 86 older entries were unread, and the evaluator couldn't see the parent-freeze state. The fix is in criterionEvidence: cite the exact gate evidence ids and the holder note that holds the proof, not just "see notes". The re-roll on the same frozen input, through record_new_evidence_then_evaluate, then passed 5/5 (evaluation a4cfb49a). Re-roll once at most; if visibility still fails, report the exact text as a tool problem.

2026-11-11 evaluation-committed-input lesson (w-0d4c): TermAl's evaluation preflight refuses with committed_input_no_eligible_run unless the NEWEST applicable terminal test result on the named root's exact HEAD passed. Passes on earlier candidates don't count. Before requesting an evaluation, make sure the latest run on that exact commit covers what failed before, and passed.

2026-11-11 (TermAl w-71e95318ea03, P1): there is no supported route to replay a retained, unconfirmed evaluation submission after its evaluator ended (termal_followup_session refuses it). If the tracker shows that no evaluation landed, start ONE fresh evaluator instead. TermAl admits it with an "earlier write outcome unknown" notice, and it can't duplicate a verdict. Retire when w-71e9 lands.
